title: 第五百六十三章 接二连三的发生第五百六十二章 心里的悔恨懊恼
content_zh:
因为王龙车队占用了街道的原因，所以现在街道上没有一个行人。
这样孤零零的一辆小车，看起来就格外显眼。
此时，围观的人也越来越多。
众人都好奇的跟在后头，看着那辆小车，心里都不禁嘀咕，这车里的人是不是脑子有问题，哪里停车不好，偏偏停在路中间？
而且，如果顺着路停也就罢了，偏偏这辆车，还是直接横在路中间的，看起来就好像是故意这么堵着路似的。
“龙哥，是辆桑塔纳。”有人说道。
“妈的，桑塔纳也敢堵路，真活腻了都。”王龙目光盯着那辆车，心里极为光火，一辆几万块钱的破车，竟然都敢挡自己车队的路，这他妈的太丢份儿了。
现在江阳市的正反两面的大佬级别人物都在旁边，看着自己被一辆桑塔纳羞辱，这以后还怎么混？
更何况现在自己刚刚在江阳市扬名，正是树立个人形象的时候，要是留下这个笑柄，那就不好看了。
“龙哥，我们过去看看。”
身边的小弟也有眼色，看出来王龙神色不对，知道这是自己表现的时候了。
血玉堂几个小弟向桑塔纳走去。
众人的目光就紧紧跟随着。
都想看看到底是怎么一回事，看看车子里到底是谁。
“里面到底是什么人啊，怎么一点动静也没有？”路人窃窃私语着，毕竟桑塔纳贴了膜，从外面根本看不到车内的情况。
“我觉得应该是吓傻了吧，外面这么一票帮派大佬，还有崔家赵家这些人在这里，车里的人恐怕也知道闯了大祸了。”
“唉，也不知道谁这么倒霉。”
“妈的，别装神弄鬼的，开门下车！”血玉堂几个小弟此时，已经来到了车子四周。
“再不开门，别怪老子们不客气了。”
有人手头晃了晃，拿出了铁棍。

咔哒，就在这时候，车门开了。
众人的目光，顿时全部聚焦在车门上了。
都等着看看，下来的到底是什么人。
一只脚下了车。
人还没有完全从车里走出来。
“曹你妈的！龙哥的车队你也敢挡！今儿个就让你好好涨涨记性！”一个比较急的小弟，抡起铁棍，上去就要来一棍子。
这小子也不怕出人命，怕啥啊，现在龙哥是江阳市炙手可热的人物，连崔家都来捧场，区区一条桑塔纳车主这种贱命算什么啊。
路人看到这一幕，胆小的都吓得转过头去。
这一铁棍下去，怕不得下车的人直接投胎重新做人啊。
王龙的嘴角也浮出一丝微笑，他并不阻拦，妈的，阻拦什么啊，这个时候就是要立威，这正是好时机，就是要让全江阳的人都知道，阻挡我王龙，不管是有心还是无意，下场就是这么惨。
“二狗，别打，别打！是我！”
伴随着哀求的喊声，下车的人，走出了车门。
顿时，围在车子周围的血玉堂几个人就傻眼了，车子里此时下来了两个人，这两个人竟然都是血玉堂的人。
当即，王龙的脸色变得铁青。
这两个人，正是自己派去殡仪馆的手下。
自己的手下，竟然开着车，堵住了自己的去路？
这不是要被其他人笑死？
“给我打，给我朝死里打！”
王龙直接喝令，妈的，自己手下都骑到自己头上了，这个时候要是不立威，那以后在江阳就等着背后被人戳戳点点吧。
看着王龙咬牙切齿的样子。

其他帮派的大佬们，谁也没有上前说一句话。
这些人都是和王龙一样的角色，当然明白王龙的心思，毕竟如果一个老大被手下人骑到头上了，那真的就是太耻辱了。
content_en:
Because Wang Long's motorcade occupied the street, there was no pedestrian on the street now.
Such a lonely car looks particularly conspicuous.
At this time, more and more people were watching.
Everyone followed curiously, looking at the small car, and couldn't help but wonder in their hearts, is there something wrong with the people in this car? Why did they park in the middle of the road?
Moreover, it would be fine if they parked along the road, but this car was still directly in the middle of the road. It looked as if it was deliberately blocking the road.
"Brother Long, this is a Santana." Someone said.
"Damn it, Santana dared to block the road. I'm so tired of living." Wang Long stared at the car, feeling extremely angry. A broken car worth tens of thousands of yuan dared to block the road of his motorcade. This was so fucking embarrassing.
Now that all the big bosses and villains in Jiangyang City are standing by, watching himself being humiliated by a Santana, how can he survive in the future?
What's more, now that he has just become famous in Jiangyang City, it is the time to establish his personal image. It will not look good if he is left as a laughing stock.
"Brother Long, let's go over and take a look."
The younger brother next to him also had a look in his eyes. He could see that something was wrong with Wang Long's expression and knew that this was the time for him to show off.
Several younger brothers from Xueyutang walked towards Santana.
Everyone's eyes followed closely.
Everyone wanted to see what was going on and who was in the car.
"Who is there inside? Why is there no movement at all?" Passers-by whispered. After all, Santana had a film on it, so you couldn't see what was going on inside the car from the outside.
"I think they must be scared out of their wits. There are so many gang bosses outside, and people like the Cui family and the Zhao family are here. The people in the car may also know that they have caused a big trouble."
"Oh, I don't know who is so unlucky."
"Damn it, stop pretending to be crazy, open the door and get out of the car!" At this time, several of the Xueyutang boys had already arrived around the car.
"If you don't open the door, don't blame me for being rude."
Someone shook his hand and took out an iron rod.
Click, at this moment, the car door opened.
Everyone's eyes immediately focused on the car door.
They were all waiting to see who was coming down.
One foot got out of the car.
The person hasn't completely gotten out of the car yet.
"Damn it, Cao! How dare you block Brother Long's motorcade! Today I'm going to let you sharpen your memory!" A rather impatient boy picked up the iron rod and tried to hit him with it.
This kid is not afraid of losing his life. What is he afraid of? Brother Long is now a very popular figure in Jiangyang City, and even the Cui family comes to support him. What does this mean life of a mere Santana owner mean?
When passers-by saw this scene, they turned their heads away in fear.
If this iron rod is removed, the people who are afraid of getting off will be reincarnated and start a new life.
A smile appeared on the corner of Wang Long's mouth. He didn't stop me. Damn, what are you blocking? This is the time to establish your authority. This is a good time to let everyone in Jiangyang know that if you block me, Wang Long, whether intentionally or unintentionally, the end will be so miserable.
"Er Gou, don't fight, don't fight! It's me!"
Along with the shouts of pleading, the people who got off the car walked out of the car door.
Immediately, the people from Xueyutang surrounding the car were dumbfounded. Two people got out of the car, and both of them turned out to be from Xueyutang.
Immediately, Wang Long's face turned livid.
These two people were the men he sent to the funeral parlor.
One of his men actually drove a car and blocked his way?
Aren’t you going to be laughed to death by others?
"Hit me, beat me to death!"
Wang Long directly ordered, "Damn it, all his men are riding on his head. If he doesn't establish his authority at this time, then he will be waiting for someone to poke him in the back in Jiangyang."
Look at Wang Long gnashing his teeth.
None of the other gang bosses came forward to say a word.These people all have the same role as Wang Lung, and of course they understand Wang Lung's thoughts. After all, it would be a shame if a boss was taken advantage of by his subordinates.
